_comment: Agent registry. Add a worker by appending an entry and deploying a matching runtime (Cloud Run Job, local daemon, or master-inline). No Master code changes — see registry.py and README 'Extending the registry'.

agents.name: echo-worker
agents.description: Placeholder worker. Echoes its input payload back as a typed result. Terminal — emits no relay messages.

agents.name: transform-worker
agents.description: Phase 2 second worker. Applies a text transform (upper/lower/reverse/count) and can relay its result through the Master to another agent.

agents.name: assistant
agents.description: Agentic assistant — a Claude tool-use loop that runs terminal commands on the operator's Mac to accomplish a natural-language goal. Read-only commands auto-run; anything else needs the operator's approval.

agents.name: mac-shell
agents.description: Runs shell commands on the operator's Mac via the outbound-only local agent. Every command is SENSITIVE — gated by the session window or per-command approval.

agents.name: cloudrun-admin
agents.description: Reads and manages Cloud Run via the Master's scoped service account. Works even when the Mac is offline. Read ops are benign; mutating ops are SENSITIVE.

agents.name: communities-scraper
agents.description: Scrapes new-construction community data (listings, pricing, DOM, descriptions) and writes it to the communities Google Sheet. Long-running Playwright job; mutates the sheet, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: newhome-source-updater
agents.description: Refreshes the FL new-home community source list: adds new communities, marks sold-out ones, emails a change report. Mutates the source sheet, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: sitemap-sync-weekly
agents.description: Weekly sitemap sync — builds sitemaps from the communities CSV in GCS and uploads them. Accepts payload.args to override the default CLI flags. Publishes sitemaps, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: bing-daily
agents.description: Daily Bing Webmaster automation — submits URLs via IndexNow and pulls the Bing SEO report. Submits to Bing, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: security-health
agents.description: Scans this Mac's security posture (disk encryption, firewall, exposed ports, credential-file permissions, remote-access software, secrets in shell history), grades it, and emails the operator a health report via SendGrid. Read-only scan; sends one email.

agents.name: security-probe
agents.description: Cloud Run job that probes the operator's own public web assets for risk — TLS cert expiry, HTTPS enforcement, missing security headers, and exposed sensitive paths (/.env, /.git) — grades them, and emails a report. Non-intrusive external scan; safe to schedule.

agents.name: incentive-social
agents.description: Scans the builder-incentives Google Sheet for fresh, customer-facing incentives (excludes mortgage rates/financing and agent/realtor bonuses), drafts Facebook + Instagram posts linked to the matching SE-Florida area page, and emails them to the operator for approval. Posting to Meta happens only after approval. Sends email and posts to social, so SENSITIVE.

agents.name: crm-office-leads
agents.description: Office-Lead CRM agent for RealGeeks. Runs on the Mac (uses the saved RealGeeks browser session). Set payload.action to one of: 'daily_report' (pull the officelead-tagged leads, analyze needs-attention/activity/per-agent, and EMAIL the daily report to the broker), 'report_only' (build + save the report files, no email), 'verify_phantom_tasks' (READ-ONLY count of future-dated 2050+ follow-up tasks). Reads the CRM and may send an email to the operator; not destructive.

agents.name: crm-task-cleanup
agents.description: Office-Lead CRM cleanup. Runs on the Mac. payload.action='clear_phantom_tasks' completes every far-future (year 2030+) follow-up task — the phantom 2052-2055 reminders left by the buggy drip workflow. Proven safe (posts only internal notes, sends NO customer email; halts if any outbound email is detected). MUTATES the live CRM, so SENSITIVE — every run needs operator approval.

agents.name: jazzysphotos-site
agents.description: Updates the jazzysphotos.com photography site (the Astro repo on this Mac). Set payload.action. BENIGN, auto-run actions: 'status' (git state + pending changes), 'build' (npm run build to validate locally, no push), 'refresh_instagram' (npm run instagram — refreshes the Instagram preview images, staged but not published). PUBLISHING actions commit + push to main, which deploys to the live site via Cloudflare (live in ~90s) — each is SENSITIVE and needs operator approval: 'update_copy' (set a top-level copy field in site.ts, payload.field + payload.value), 'add_photo' (payload.image_path/title/alt/category[/featured/order]), 'remove_photo' (payload.slug), 'publish' (commit + push whatever is pending, payload.message). 'goal' runs a Claude tool-use loop scoped to the repo for free-form edits — its shell commands are gated per command.
